narrative.overview: JobPilot reads like the chart pasted on a train coach on departure day: a railway-blue header band, buff paper ruled into bands, and every application on one row with a reference number and a status. It is an Operate surface: the world contributes only type, palette, density and one signature move, the PNR plus the status ladder.
keyCharacteristics: Railway-blue header band over a buff Prepare strip; bands with tinted head strips.
PNR references and figures in tabular Martian Mono; headings and labels in Archivo Narrow caps.
One match ramp (five blocks) and one status ladder, used identically on every page.

rules.name: The One Maroon Rule
rules.body: A screen has at most one maroon control. The header's Find jobs link hides on the home page, where the page's own Find button is the primary.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear only when they carry state (done, caution, refused). Decoration is done with rules and type, never colour.

rules.name: The Figures-Are-Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything a user compares down a column (PNR, score, count, date offset) is set in Martian Mono with tabular numerals. Prose is never mono.

rules.name: The Ruled-Not-Raised Rule
rules.body: Separate things with a 1px rule or a tinted strip, never a shadow or a floating card.

dos: Do give every job and application its PNR and ladder, on every page that lists them.
Do keep one maroon action per screen (Signal Maroon, 48px on the home page).
Do head every group of rows with a band strip and, on desktop, a column-head row.
Do set PNRs, scores, counts and dates in Martian Mono with tabular numerals.
donts: Don't add shadows, floating cards or large radii; this world is ruled paper (3px corners).
Don't use colour for decoration; green, amber and red only for done, caution and refused.
Don't reuse railway jargon for meaning (no "RAC" or "CNF" as statuses); labels stay plain (Saved, Applied, Interview, Offer).
Don't use a coloured border-left above 1px to mark state; use a ladder step or a tag.
